record.title: Burundi closure of Gatumba after M23 capture of Uvira
record.movement: Traders, transporters, patients and cross-border travellers.
record.enforcement: Three independently authored local reports document resumed traffic and traveller accounts.
record.consequences: Disrupted work and family connections; drivers stranded.
record.official_rationale: Security response after AFC/M23 captured Uvira.
record.uncertainty: Ordinary closure onset 10–11 December 2025: police blocked the outbound route on the 10th and total closure was confirmed on the 11th. The IWACU December 12 retrospective date conflicts. February 23 ordinary reopening preferred over the Burundi Eco late January claim because the February 2 report confirms continued closure; January official passage exception documented.
